newsitem.title: USA: Suburban Lodges to offer 3.45 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Suburban Lodges to offer 3.45 mln shrs.

text.p: Suburban Lodges of America Inc said on Wednesday that it plans to offer 3.45 million shares of common stock at $18.75 per share.
The offering consists of 2,977,983 shares being sold by the company and 22,017 shares to be sold by certain shareholders. The remaining 450,000 shares are for any over-allotments.
The companys said the net proceeds are expected to be used to fund development of additional company-owned Suburban Lodge facilities.
Suburban Lodges develops, manages and franchises hotels.
